Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and low specific gravity are also noted. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
